observations.rationale: The substantive provisions of section 1021(i)(8)(B) describing a one-participant retirement plan are external to the supplied source text and remain unresolved without altering the complete reading of the exception in the defined benefit plan statement rule.
The actor 'the Secretary' is directly specified in the statutory text of subsection (a)(2)(D)(ii) and is already faithfully represented in claim C0021.

observations.quote: In the case of a defined benefit plan, the requirements of paragraph (1)(B)(i) shall be treated as met with respect to a participant if at least once each year the administrator provides to the participant notice of the availability of the pension benefit statement and the ways in which the participant may obtain such statement.
observations.rationale: The alternative notice rule for defined benefit plans is already completely and faithfully represented in C0027 with its companion delivery permission in C0028; qualification links are reserved for the subsequent pass.
